# Background Lore fixtures

Fetched unchanged on 2026-09-15 from the official PF2e repository:

- [Guard, PF2e 8.5.0](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/foundryvtt/pf2e/pf2e-8.5.0/packs/pf2e/backgrounds/guard.json): empty `trainedSkills.lore`; description grants Legal or Warfare Lore.
- [Guard, master](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/foundryvtt/pf2e/master/packs/backgrounds/guard.json): `trainedSkills.lore` contains the choice descriptor `<Legal or Warfare> Lore`.

The production builder regression supplies native actor preparation as a stand-in. It proves payloads and write ordering, not live Foundry behavior. Publication/license metadata is retained in each fixture; fixtures are excluded from release archives.
